title: Equipment column: armor, vanity and dye; 5–7 accessories with visibility toggles; Misc tab (pet, light pet, minecart, mount, hook); defense shield
player_outcome:
The right-hand column matches Terraria:
- Dye | Vanity | Equip columns for helmet, shirt and pants, then 5 accessory rows (6 in Expert, 7 in Master), each with faint silhouettes and an eye toggle.
- A shield badge shows your defense, with the set bonus on hover.
- A Misc tab holds pet, light pet, minecart, mount and hook slots with their dyes.
design:
New game/UI/Inventory/EquipmentPanel.cs in the Equipment rect.
- A tab row of TextureButtons: tab_equipment and tab_misc, plus a disabled Housing tab placeholder for the NPC phase.
- The page container swaps between the two pages.

Equipment page: a 3-column grid (Dye | Vanity | Equip), each 44 · SlotScale.
- Rows: 3 armor rows plus AccessorySlotsUnlocked accessory rows. Locked rows 6–7 are hidden unless occupied; an occupied locked row shows with SlotKind.Locked.
- Kinds: SlotKind.Dye, Vanity and Equip. Empty hints: slot_head, slot_body, slot_legs, slot_accessory, slot_dye.
- Empty-slot hover text (TooltipFollower text mode): 'Helmet', 'Shirt', 'Pants', 'Accessory', 'Social Helmet', 'Dye'.
- An eye TextureButton per accessory row toggles the PlayerInventory.HiddenAccessories bit. The avatar reading this bit is P3 or art work.
Misc page: 5 rows (Pet, Light Pet, Minecart, Mount, Hook) × (Dye | Item), with silhouettes and filters from SlotFilters.

New game/UI/Inventory/DefenseBadge.cs: the shield sprite (36 px) with the defense number (16 px, outlined) centred, left of the column. Hover shows '{n} Defense' and the active set bonus. This replaces the _defense and _setBonus labels.
Clicks route through InventoryScreen.Clicks using the SlotAreas VanityArmor, VanityAccessories, Dyes, Misc and MiscDyes. Core recomputes stats (P2-05).
files_modify: game/UI/InventoryScreen.Layout.cs — host the EquipmentPanel; accessory rows feed UiState.AccessoryRows
tests:
ui.cmds:
- `give iron_helmet 1` / `ui inventory` / `invclick backpack <slot> right` / `assert player.defense > 0`.
- `invclick armor 0 right` (swaps to vanity) / `assert player.defense == 0`.
- `give grappling_hook 1` / `invclick backpack <slot> right` / `assert inv.grappling_hook == 0` / `ui close`.
verification: Lavapipe screenshot of an Expert world inventory: 6 accessory rows, silhouettes, shield badge; Misc tab screenshot
risks: Vanity and dye items do not exist yet (0 in data). The slots are ready for P3's items; until then they only accept armor used as vanity.
